title: Split Tasks Between Two Assistants
src: Walmart OA, IIT BHU. Coding question 3 of 3.
body:
There are n tasks and two assistants, A1 and A2. Every task is given to exactly one of them. Doing task i earns benefit1[i] if A1 does it and benefit2[i] if A2 does it.

A1 must do exactly k tasks, and A2 does the other n - k. Return the maximum total benefit.

Function to complete

Complete maxBen(k, benefit1, benefit2). It returns the maximum total benefit.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: First line: n k. Second line: benefit1[0..n-1]. Third line: benefit2[0..n-1].
out: One integer: the maximum total benefit.

samples.ex: A1 takes tasks 1 and 3 (10 + 30), A2 takes task 2 (25). Total 65.
k = n, so A1 does everything: 15 + 25 + 35 + 45.

wrong.why: gives A1 the k tasks with the largest benefit1, ignoring benefit2
lets every task go to its better assistant, ignoring the exact k

    benefit2 = list(map(int, _t[_p:_p + (_n)])); _p += (_n)
    _r = Solution().maxBen(k, benefit1, benefit2)
